title: Enter the August portrait sketch competition in New York
content: TheGrand Central Academyin New York will be hosting a Portrait Sketch Competition later this summer. Ten contestants will each paint six one-session portraits over the course of three days, from August 27-29.The portraits will be judged as a group. First place is $1500 and second place is $500. There's no application fee, and it's easy to enter, but just be sure you do so by July 1.Here's the link to the online application form.---The painting above is by Sargent, who won't be in the running.GCA Facebook pageGCA websitePortrait Sketch Competition website info page
